design.initialState: either author-decoded state, with separately counted denominators
design.windowSelection: Fixed disjoint windows per horizon starting at sample zero, with no window chosen for a particular outcome.
design.claim: A departure and return observed inside one window distinguishes first observed exit from endpoint change for the published state labels.
design.limits: Author-decoded figure excerpt selected by the study to illustrate coincident switching. It supports a path witness and descriptive counts. It cannot independently calibrate or validate stationary rates.
